name: print-social-driveshare-posts-violet-circle-crop-photos-teal-badges
title: DriveShare car-sharing pack in violet with circle-cropped driver photos and teal '50% Off' badges
whatItIs: Five violet square posts with a simple car-outline logo, circle-cropped photos of people driving, teal circular '50% off' badges, small phone-and-pin app icons, dot grids, and headlines ('Get Around with Ease', 'Your Ride Solution', 'Share the Ride, Save Money').
whatItMeans: Friendly and modern; circle photo crops and a bright teal badge make a mobility service feel approachable and rewarding.
techniques: Crop driver photos into circles for a warm, personal feel.
Use a bright teal badge for discounts against a violet field.
Repeat a small app-icon device to reinforce the digital product.

vocabulary.definition: A photo masked into a circular shape.
A circular shape highlighting a percentage-off offer.
